artifacts.summary: Inventories all 20 manifests' routing blocks, confirms dependency preconditions landed, and corrects the task's own premise: /epi is a live surviving caller of command-route-skill.sh that must be migrated before retirement.

next_steps: Run /plan 127 to create the implementation plan, incorporating the epi.md migration and the Check A/C re-scoping design.

memory_candidates.content: When a task's DEPENDS ON clause asserts 'no remaining caller' for a script slated for retirement, verify this against the actual codebase rather than trusting the task description -- in this repo, test files sometimes already document known exceptions verbatim (e.g. test-routing-resolution.sh explicitly names /epi.md as 'the one surviving command-route-skill.sh caller'), which is a strong, pre-existing signal worth grepping for before concluding a caller census from scratch.

This repo's manifest-routing ladder (manifest-routing-lib.sh) treats op as an opaque string with no hardcoded research/plan/implement enum, so an extension-specific custom op (e.g. present's 'critique') resolves through the exact same routing_agents.{op}.{task_type} path as the three standard ops -- no special-case code is ever needed to add a new op to an extension's manifest.
